answer: Make every payout a slow quartz clock. A new key's rewards vest over 40 epochs (estimate: about 10 days, assuming four epochs a day); until then they stay locked and can be clawed back if juries catch the key copying or colluding. A sybil farm earns only a plume of smoke it can't spend, and each fraud finding burns its whole locked pile. Every claw-back leaves an echo on-ledger that teaches graders the farm's habits. Tradeoff: honest newcomers wait for liquidity, so release 10% at once to cover running costs.
